newsitem.title: CANADA: Canada dollar ends firmer, quiet overnight seen.
newsitem.headline: Canada dollar ends firmer, quiet overnight seen.

text.p: * The Canadian dollar ended slightly firmer at C$1.3665 (US$0.7317) on Monday from Friday's close at C$1.3680 (US$0.7309), traders said.
* Canada unit seen trading between C$1.3640 - C$1.3690 overnight * Investors awaiting U.S. Federal Reserve Chairman Alan Greenspan's testimony on Wednesday.
Traders said flows were thin in Canada and very little movement is expected ahead of testimony from U.S. Federal Reserve Chairman Alan Greenspan on Wednesday before Congress.
"We've got Greenspan and some numbers coming up so we'll have something new to chomp on," one trader said.

On the crosses, the Canadian dollar rose to 1.2425 marks from Friday's close of 1.2353 marks and edged up to 88.72 yen from 87.95 yen. ((Paul Casciato, Reuters Toronto Bureau 416 941-8100 or email: paul.casciato@reuters.com))
